# `harness-dsh-profile`

> install the rickylabs dsh profile

Shipped by [`experiments/routers/dsh`](../../..). This page is *what it does*;
*why it does it that way* is [`experiments/routers/dsh/README.md`](../../../README.md).

## Exit codes

| code | name | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0` | `ok` | installed, or already matching |
| `1` | `drift` | check found a difference between what is installed and what this package would write |
| `2` | `usage` | the argv did not name a command this tool has |
| `3` | `unwritable` | the profile directory could not be written or linked |

Read from `EXIT` and `EXIT_MEANINGS` in [`experiments/routers/dsh/src/cli.ts`](../../../src/cli.ts). The `exit codes`
block in the help text below renders from those same two constants, so this table, that block
and the number the process actually returns cannot disagree.

## `harness-dsh-profile --help`

```text
harness-dsh-profile — install the rickylabs dsh profile

usage
  harness-dsh-profile install         write the profile and link this bundle into it
  harness-dsh-profile check           exit non-zero when the installed profile has drifted
  harness-dsh-profile path            print the profile directory (for DSH_HOME scripting)

options
  --home <dir>     dsh home (default: $DSH_HOME, else ~/.dsh)
  --name <name>    profile name (default: rickylabs)
  --surface <s>    tui | web (default: tui)
  --dry-run        with install: report what would change, write nothing

after installing
  dsh --profile rickylabs --dump-config     show the composed entry list

exit codes:
  0  installed, or already matching
  1  check found a difference between what is installed and what this package would write
  2  the argv did not name a command this tool has
  3  the profile directory could not be written or linked
```
